title: Automated Monthly Report
prompt:
Create a repeatable import-clean-summarize workflow.

Skills: Power Query, PivotTables and refresh workflows.

Use the supplied synthetic CSV at assets/data/practical-20-automated-monthly-report.csv. A small copy/pastable sample is included below in case the CSV is not directly downloadable from the lesson page. Complete the work in a separate .xlsx copy, preserve a raw-data sheet, and check the result against the acceptance criteria. Then answer the short grading check; it does not validate the workbook itself.

Sample CSV (synthetic):
Month,Region,Sales
Jan,East,1200
Jan,West,900
Feb,East,1450
Feb,West,1120

options: Refresh source queries, validate row counts/totals, refresh summaries, then record the run result.
Refresh only the PivotTable while leaving source queries stale.
Delete source data after a report is created.
Hide failed refreshes if the old chart remains visible.

expected_output: Expected: the refresh procedure can be repeated without manual reconstruction; stale or failed refreshes are apparent.

public_tests.name: Sample-data acceptance
checklist: Input records are preserved and data types are checked.
Totals/results reconcile with a small independent calculation.
An edge case, duplicate or threshold boundary is tested where relevant.

public_tests.name: Server-side answer check
public_tests.note: A text/choice check does not execute Excel or inspect the workbook artifact.

acceptance_criteria: Expected: the refresh procedure can be repeated without manual reconstruction; stale or failed refreshes are apparent.
Use a labeled result area and document formulas, assumptions or transformation steps.
Compare actual results with a manual/independently calculated expected result and test one edge case.
Keep source data intact and request human review of the completed workbook; do not treat the text grader as artifact validation.
hints: Import data without losing dates, decimals or leading zeros.
Separate raw inputs, calculations and presentation outputs.
Test empty inputs, duplicated keys, boundary values or missing matches as appropriate to the scenario.

grading_config.correct_answer: Refresh source queries, validate row counts/totals, refresh summaries, then record the run result.

grading_method: Server-side choice check of the submitted answer/expression only; does not execute Excel or inspect the workbook. This workbook-practice task needs a human-reviewed artifact and test evidence for full acceptance. Repeatable reporting needs explicit refresh order and visible failure/staleness handling, plus a reconciliation check.
retry_policy: Retries are permitted. A failed string/choice submission does not complete the exercise. Course files do not define XP; platform-wide server logic applies.
